title: Oronok and the Cipher of Damnation
summary: Oronok Torn-heart and his sons recover the Cipher's fragments across Shadowmoon Valley before a final confrontation.
opening: The Hand of Gul'dan shadows the land. Oronok's family must find what was scattered before the power tied to that place can be confronted.
reviewNote: The Blizzard attunement guide lists the sequence; original quest dialogue is needed for motives and the final outcome.

chapters.title: At the Hand of Gul'dan
chapters.body: Establish the threat and why Oronok enters the search.

chapters.title: Three sons, three trails
chapters.body: Follow Grom'tor, Ar'tor, and Borak through separate fragment quests.

chapters.title: The Cipher gathered
chapters.body: Reconstruct how the fragments are recovered and brought together.

chapters.title: The final confrontation
chapters.body: Verify the original concluding scene and its consequence.
